acceptance_criteria.statement: One exported deeply frozen capability-grant grammar pins an exact complete capability-grant Schema contract.
Schema covers and requires every always-emitted runtime property including requestedModelClass and closes top-level and allowedExternal objects.
Runtime validates the selected channel type as a non-empty primitive string and cannot emit a non-string allowedOutputChannels entry.
Schema and runtime agree on arrays, external read domains/methods, model class, modelPolicy, booleans, approval identifiers, and output channels.
Previously accepted external-read, model-class, and deep-immutability behavior remains unchanged.
A dependency-free deterministic contract harness accepts representative emitted grants and rejects required missing, extra, type, method, model-class, array, and channel negatives.
Tests prove exact schema/grammar equality and deep freezing of both exported grammar and compiled grants.
Exactly the three allowed files change; npm test and git diff --check pass without dependency, network, commit, transfer, or external changes.
